operation.description: Explicit browser-session Platform Admin action, separate from free-price eligibility. Each page handles at most 10000 envelopes and 150000 line execution attempts without splitting jobs; single jobs above the supported attempt bound are left untouched and pagination advances past them. Evidence is aggregated in PostgreSQL. Statements have a 10-second limit, lock waits 2 seconds, and the action 60 seconds; exceeded limits return 503. Terminal gateway-run UNKNOWN envelopes only; native/nonterminal/ambiguous jobs, including repeated envelope UUIDs, are excluded. Apply with expected_count and reason. The unused envelope settles at ZERO; line reservations own charges and retain pending/unknown holds. Known settled line sum is evidence, never charged twice. NULL usage and observations remain unchanged. Counts and totals only, including personal workspaces; line held amount is a known floor when line_unbounded_count is positive. Preview is advisory; changed count conflicts atomically. Follow apply next_offset; resolved rows leave the scan. Each reservation is reconciled at most once, but replaying a request can resolve another page of the same size after an uncertain COMMIT. Preview again instead of blindly replaying. No automatic action or retry.

200.description: Count only, or atomically resolved at zero cost

409.description: Eligible page count changed; preview again
